purpose: Versioned authority for server-derived abuse signals on the student possession-token boundary. This authority is operational observability only and is not incident-response evidence or launch authority.

posture.observe: one or more recent medium signals and no high/critical signal
posture.investigate: one or more recent high/critical signals

known_external_boundary.blind_spot: Invalid-token brute force and network-origin abuse cannot be attributed reliably inside PostgreSQL because rejected tokens have no stable link_id and the database does not own the trustworthy client IP boundary.
known_external_boundary.required_future_control: Deploy-layer or edge-layer network-origin abuse control and alert delivery before production deployment evidence can be promoted.
